instruction.text: Build the portrait of Robert Burns.

feedback.end: Have you heard of Robert Burns? He is a very famous Scottish poet who was alive during the 1700s. Let’s find out more about him...

instruction.text: Find Alloway on the map of Scotland.

feedback.end: Burns was born in Alloway in 1759. His parents were farmers, and he lived with them and his six younger siblings in a house that his father built!

instruction.text: These are Robert Burns’ parents. Find his father.

atoms.a: Why do you think Burns was educated by his father?

b.sound: He could not afford to go to school.

end.text: When Burns was a child, school was not free. His parents did not have a lot of money, so he only went to a proper school for a few years. However, Burns’ father made sure he was educated and taught him to read and write.
